name: Dollarcity
owner: Dollarcity (Latin American variety-store chain; Dollarama Inc. holds 60.1%, jointly controlled with the founding stockholders)

logoSources.notes: Official site logo. The SVG only wraps an embedded 3963x880 PNG (yellow wordmark with dark-green outline), which was extracted losslessly and placed on the brand green #00552E, reproducing the official Dollarcity Peru avatar (https://graph.facebook.com/DollarcityPeru/picture?type=large&width=720&height=720, kept for reference). Local copies: tools/seed/logo-src/dollarcity/. Badge re-composed 2026-10-01 (data polish) so it reads at 32 px: the wordmark is re-stacked as 'Dollar' over 'city' (cut between 'r' and 'c', where no yellow letter pixel is); on one line its 10 letters were ~3 px tall at 32 px.
Same embedded PNG, trimmed, transparent background, 512 px wide.

notes: Variety / 'dollar store' chain. Ownership: Dollarama raised its equity interest in Dollarcity to 60.1% in 2025 under joint control with the founding stockholders (Dollarama press release, e.g. https://www.tipranks.com/news/press-releases/dollarama-increases-equity-interest-and-expands-partnership-in-latin-america); Wikidata parent organisation Q3033947 = Dollarama. Brand colours from the official logo: green #00552E, yellow #EBDB32. Store count: Peru Retail 2026-07-02, 'alcanzando un total de 116 tiendas operativas en el país'. The store locator (dollarcity.com/ubicaciones, Mapbox app) has no Peru-specific listing URL that could be found (only es-gt/locations exists), so no locator snapshot was taken. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): 12 features, 8 with brand=Dollarcity + brand:wikidata=Q107120814 (NSI preset, shop=variety_store); 2 'Dollarcity' tagged shop=supermarket; one 'Dollar City' is amenity=bureau_de_change (exchange office, NOT the chain) -> requiring a shop=* tag excludes it.
